parsed.rationale: All three types — `SheetDraggingKey` in `WXUI/OverlaySheet.swift`, `ThemePickerActiveKey` in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift`, and `UITestingModeKey` also in `Wallpaper/ThemePickerState.swift` — are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature`. The structural match (shared_field_count: 1, no differing_slots, no Jaccard score) indicates they share only the trivial shape of a zero-field SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey`-style type alias, not any meaningful domain logic. Each key encodes a distinct, unrelated piece of environment state (sheet dragging, theme picker activation, UI testing mode), so the coincidence is purely structural. Merging or extracting them would conflate unrelated concerns across two separate packages (`WXUI` and `Wallpaper`) without any real reduction in complexity.
